e.meaning: short form of Luigino, Giorgino and similar names
e.etymology: An Italian short form of pet names ending in -gino, such as Luigino (from Luigi, Louis) and Giorgino (from Giorgio, George).

e.etymology: From Hebrew adin, gentle or delicate. In the Bible Adina is a man, one of King David's warriors; in modern Hebrew it is a girl's name.

e.meaning: bright star in Tagalog; gold in Persian; young palm tree in Arabic
e.etymology: Several unrelated names share this form. In Arabic Tala is a young palm tree, in Persian tala is gold, and in Tagalog tala is a bright star and the name of a star goddess.

e.etymology: A 20th-century spelling of Ashley, an English surname and place name from Old English aesc (ash tree) and leah (woodland clearing).
